card.name: Suppository word endings after sup
card.fires_on: The ending of a split word, mainly "positories" after "sup" in "belladonna and opium suppositories" or vaginal suppository names. It also fires on "ings" in "Clippings".

modes.label: Suppositories ending
modes.description: The "positories" ending after "sup" in suppository product names.
modes.example: Consider these risks when prescribing or dispensing belladonna and opium sup<<positories>>.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: The ending of a split ordinary word such as "Clippings".
